text:
oncall-bot: alert: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate in us-east-1. PagerDuty routing: rbc-prod alerted. root ts: 1782345678

Alex: yup, seeing ~8% 5xx over 3m. multiple user errors coming in. starting triage.

Maria: no deploys in last hour. looks tied to dedicated pool autoscaler chatter for pool-3.

Sandeep: pulling proxy logs now. lots of `upstream read timeout` and 502 from inference-proxy.

Jules: can someone suppress PD flood while we investigate? current noise is burying new signals.

Alex: applied PD suppression for rbc-prod for 30m — manual ack only for criticals. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: PagerDuty suppression active (user: Alex) for 30 minutes. note: suppression doesn't auto-ack existing incidents.

Maria: customer impact quick notes: heavy-prompt tenants in us-east-1 see ~12% failures; p95 latency up ~2x. CS has 3 open tickets.

Sandeep: found kernel OOMs on hosts running model variant `quant-small-v2` between 1782345600-1782345700. pods flapping.

Jules: mitigation proposal: 1) stop routing traffic to quant-small-v2 in us-east-1 2) fallback to quant-medium-v1 3) increase proxy mem limit for short window.

Alex: +1. Sandeep, can you push a temporary runtime rule? sample:
```
route:
  region: us-east-1
  exclude_models: ["quant-small-v2"]
  fallback: "quant-medium-v1"
```

Sandeep: pushed runtime routing change (id: rchg-b3f9) — rolling out now.

deploy-bot: runtime routing change detected. id: rchg-b3f9, user: Sandeep, ts: 1782345852.

Maria: error-rate dropped to ~2% within ~90s after switch. p95 returning toward baseline.

Jules: follow-ups while we monitor:
- add grafana panel for model-variant OOM spikes
- change PD grouping key to include model_variant and region
- add playbook steps for temporarily quieting PD and performing handoffs

Alex: opening PD ticket for grouping/rate-limit tweaks. suggestion: grouping key `service:model_variant:region`, rate-limit 1 incident per 5m per group.

Maria: recommend new alert: sustained node OOMs by host, e.g. `count(kube_oom_events{job=~"node"}) by (host) > 3` over 5m, owned by eng-sre-alerts.

Sandeep: draft alertmanager snippet for dedupe/rate-limiting:
```
route:
  receiver: "pagerduty"
  group_by: ["service","model_variant","region"]
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 1h
```

Jules: test in staging before prod rollout. please open PR and link back to this thread.

Alex: PD ticket PD-4879 created (https://pagerduty.company/PD-4879). assigned to Alex for implementation, oncall-sre for review.

Maria: grafana board live: https://grafana.company/d/abc123/model-variant-ooms (OOMs, 5xx by model_variant, routing hits).

Sandeep: routing safety PR opened to add fallback flag and per-model circuit-breaker: https://git.company/routing/merge/182

oncall-bot: handoff reminder: Alex on-call until 1782346800. next on-call: Emily. please document unresolved items before handoff.

Emily: I'll take over at handoff. summarise action items in a single list please.

Alex: handoff summary:
- PD suppression active (30m from 1782345678)
- runtime routing change rchg-b3f9 excluding quant-small-v2 in us-east-1
- PD ticket PD-4879 for grouping/rate-limits
- grafana dashboard id: abc123
- open PRs: routing safety #182, alertmanager snippet draft
- customer impact reduced: failures from ~12% -> ~2%; CS tickets: 3 (two high, one medium)

Jules: I'll schedule a 30m retro with eng-sre, eng-runtime, and oncall rotation to refine thresholds and runbook.

Maria: also propose tagging memory-hungry variants in model catalog to prevent scheduling onto low-memory nodes.

Sandeep: todo: correlate pod memory usage with prompt-size histograms — may need tenant-level limits.

Emily: ack. will pick up PD ticket and coordinate staging test for grouping config.

Alex: switching to passive monitoring. reopen if anything spikes again. :pray:

oncall-bot: thread closed for automated notifications. manual posts still allowed. last ts: 1782346310
